method_change: replace the non-improving stochastic beam with deterministic exhaustive replacement search centered on SEARCH-002 best candidate
wall_clock_semantics: Total process elapsed from search start through final search-result materialization must not exceed 300 seconds. New candidate evaluation stops no later than 298.5 seconds, reserving 1.5 seconds for finalization. If total elapsed nevertheless exceeds 300 seconds, record BUDGET_OVERRUN and do not assert a budget-compliant exhaustion disposition.
hardware_resource_class: single-host CPU only; no GPU requirement; ordinary local execution environment
restart_policy: one run; failures are preserved; any restart receives a successor search pass

seed_policy.reason: search order is fully deterministic lexicographic enumeration

checkpoint_policy: preserve every strict best-score improvement; emit exact progress counters and final result without extending the total wall-clock limit

search_space.replacement_rule: for each selected comparator position, replace its original comparator by one of the other 77 valid channel pairs; preserve all unselected positions and comparator order

completion_semantics: If all declared Hamming-1 and Hamming-2 replacements are evaluated before the compute deadline, record LOCAL_NEIGHBORHOOD_EXHAUSTED. This is only a property of the declared neighborhood and grants no global lower-bound or nonexistence authority.
forbidden_inferences: local neighborhood exhaustion implies global nonexistence
search exhaustion establishes a lower bound
no witness means 45 comparators are necessary
immutability: Any search-space, time, worker, or resource expansion requires a successor search pass.
